supersededReason: Both cases observed successful late-owner release but their fixed fake-clock pump checked route absence before asynchronous admission drain and route dismissal finished. Only those final waits were changed to bounded observable route-removal loops with real event turns. The pre-release assertions continue to require a visible route and retired provider. No production source changed after provider145 pass.

Close pending factory/load/atomic refresh retires lease promptly, blocks route exit until one successful owner release

ordinary Disconnect cancels never-emitted staged watcher, awaits cancellation, and keeps owner alive until release
ordinary failed owner blocks reconnect until explicit Close retry
